    About First Digital USD

    First Digital USD (FDUSD) is a US-dollar stablecoin issued by First Digital and backed by cash and cash-equivalent reserves.

    Where this FDUSD price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (FDUSD/USDT), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.15B FDUSD (supply last updated November 2, 2026).
